# process parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:processParameter`](gmeow-processParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/processParameter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

An input parameter to the generative process — a [`PitchInterval`](../classes/gmeow-PitchInterval.md), [`TimeMapping`](../classes/gmeow-TimeMapping.md), distribution description, or other entity. Non-functional: a process may have many parameters.
